description: MH-01 is the Regional Transport Office for South Mumbai, widely known as the Tardeo RTO. As the oldest RTO office in Maharashtra, it manages vehicle registration, licensing, and transport permits for the city's most prominent commercial and administrative hubs.
address: Old Bodyguard Lane, Tulsiwadi, Tardeo, Mumbai, Maharashtra

description: The MH-02 Regional Transport Office serves the Western Suburbs of Mumbai, specifically the Andheri region. It is responsible for vehicle registration, licensing, and enforcing transport regulations in one of the most densely populated residential and commercial hubs of the city.
address: Regional Transport Office, D/111, Ambivali Village, New Manish Nagar, Versova Road, Andheri (West), Mumbai, Maharashtra

description: The MH-03 RTO, widely known as the Wadala RTO, serves the Eastern Suburbs of Mumbai. It manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the eastern corridor of the Mumbai metropolitan region.
address: B/2, 3rd Floor, Wadala Truck Terminal, Wadala Road, Mumbai, Maharashtra

description: The MH-04 Regional Transport Office (RTO) serves the city of Thane and is one of the most prominent transport offices in the Konkan division. It is responsible for essential services such as vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road safety enforcement for the rapidly expanding Thane metropolitan area.
address: Regional Transport Officer, Near Central Jail, Thane (West), Maharashtra

description: The MH-05 RTO is the Deputy Regional Transport Office serving the Kalyan region in the Thane district of Maharashtra. It handles vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and traffic regulation enforcement for the Kalyan-Dombivli metropolitan area and its surrounding talukas.
address: Sahyadri Nagar, Chikanghar, Near Birla School, Kalyan (West), District Thane, Maharashtra
